reason: A read-only local DeepSeek Harness plugin that visualizes cross-session progress, token usage, context composition, activity, and estimated costs through dashboards and analytics views.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中以仪表盘、图表和明细面板查看所有会话的进度、Token 使用、上下文占用、活动情况与估算成本。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides dashboards and analytics views for session progress, token usage, context occupancy, activity, and estimated costs.

capabilities: Reads session statistics, token usage, context, and status projections
Registers and reads a token history projection for heatmap data
Displays cross-session dashboards, charts, tables, filters, and detail panels
Estimates token costs using configured model pricing and currency options
